name: Kerala Coconut Fish Tacos
classification_note: Equals approved pool item #7 (Malabar Fish Taco) in concept; naming differs (Kerala vs Malabar). Treat as the same development track.
cooking_method: Marinate, pan-sear/shallow-fry fish to 63 °C, tacos with coconut crema and slaw

portion.construction: crisp-edged fish pieces on tortilla, coconut crema, slaw

steps: Marinate fish 20-30 min at ≤ 4 °C (acid limits time).
Dust in rice flour; pan-sear/shallow-fry until crisp edges; probe 63 °C (145 °F).
Warm tortillas; assemble with sauce, slaw, onion; fry curry leaf to garnish.

plating: Three tacos, white sauce, green slaw, fried curry leaf.
food_safety: Fish to 63 °C (145 °F); fish species and sourcing TBD (parasite destruction/supplier documentation per official guidance).
FISH allergen: dedicated utensils and label; shared fryer/pan = cross-contact.

pairing.hypothesis: Wheat softness and carbonation suit light fish and coconut.
